infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KinBech uses your location while the app is open to show nearby listings and auto-fill your city or district when you choose.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KinBech uses the camera when you take listing photos or record a short product video.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: KinBech uses the microphone for voice calls with buyers and sellers, and while you record a short listing video.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: KinBech needs access to your photo library so you can upload profile and listing images.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: KinBech may save edited listing photos back to your library when you choose to export them.

plugins.photosPermission: KinBech needs photo library access so you can upload listing and profile images.
plugins.cameraPermission: KinBech uses the camera when you take listing photos or record a short product video (max 30 seconds).

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow KinBech to use your location while the app is open to show nearby listings and auto-fill city or district.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow KinBech to use your location while the app is open to show nearby listings and auto-fill city or district.

plugins.microphonePermission: KinBech uses the microphone for voice calls with buyers and sellers, and while you record a short listing video.
